# H2 Haplotype Determines Susceptibility to Superantigen-Induced Acute Lung Injury 
## Authors: Chloe E. Weyer-Nichols^1^, Chintada Nageswara Rao^2^, Taylor H. Carter^1^, Kiesha M. Wilson^1^, Prakash Nagarkatti^1^, Mitzi Nagarkatti^1*^
### Institutions: ^1^Department of Pathology, Microbiology, and Immunology, University of South Carolina School of Medicine, Columbia, SC 29209, USA; ^2^ Department of Drug Discovery and Biomedical Sciences, College of Pharmacy, University of South Carolina, Columbia, SC, 29208, USA
### Corresponding Author: ^*^Mitzi Nagarkatti, Ph.D., Basic Science Bldg. 1, Rm C-26, Columbia, SC, 2929, USA
Data Analysis/Quality Control Code for Reproducibility

**Note:** The processed Seurat objects and V(D)J table used for downstream analysis are available through the associated data repository. These include:

- `integrated.RDS`: integrated Seurat object containing all cells across conditions
- `cd3_pos.RDS`: CD3e+ T cell subset generated from the integrated object
- `vdj_all.RDS`: combined V(D)J annotation table

The code below documents the full analysis workflow beginning with the raw Cell Ranger outputs, but users may begin from the processed RDS files for downstream visualization and analysis.

```{r}
set.seed(0311)
```


## LOAD LIBRARIES 
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr) 
library(patchwork)
library(readr) 
library("data.table") 
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(glue)
library(glmGamPoi)
```


## LOAD DATA
```{r}
BL6_VEHgz <- Seurat::Read10X("BL6_VEH_sample_sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix", gene.column = 2, cell.column = 1, unique.features = TRUE,strip.suffix = FALSE)
BL6_SEBgz <- Seurat::Read10X("BL6_SEB_sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix",gene.column = 2,cell.column = 1,unique.features = TRUE,strip.suffix = FALSE)
C3H_VEHgz <- Seurat::Read10X("C3H_VEH_sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix", gene.column = 2, cell.column = 1, unique.features = TRUE,strip.suffix = FALSE)
C3H_SEBgz <- Seurat::Read10X("C3H_SEB_sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix",gene.column = 2,cell.column = 1,unique.features = TRUE,strip.suffix = FALSE)
```


## CREATE SEURAT OBJECTS
```{r}
BL6_VEH <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = BL6_VEHgz[["Gene Expression"]], project = "triseq", min.cells = 5)
BL6_VEH[["ADT"]] <- Seurat::CreateAssayObject(counts = BL6_VEHgz[["Antibody Capture"]])
BL6_VEH$stim <- "BL6_VEH"
# store mitochondrial percentage in object meta data
BL6_VEH <- Seurat::PercentageFeatureSet(BL6_VEH, pattern = "^mt-", col.name = "percent.mt")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
saveRDS(BL6_VEH,"BL6_VEH_RAW.RDS")
```

## DOUBLET FINDER PREPROCESSING
```{r}
#pK Identification (no ground-truth)
sweep.res.list_BL6_VEH <- paramSweep(BL6_VEH, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats_BL6_VEH <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list_BL6_VEH, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn_BL6_VEH <- find.pK(sweep.stats_BL6_VEH)
bcmvn_plot <- ggplot(bcmvn_BL6_VEH, aes(x = pK, y = BCmetric)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "BCmvn vs pK",
  x = "pK",
  y = "BCmvn")
print(bcmvn_plot) #ideal pK is the one with the highest AUC, in this case 0.02
```

```{r}
annotations <- Idents(BL6_VEH)
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations) 
print(homotypic.prop)
```

```{r}
nExp_poi <- round(0.016*nrow(BL6_VEH@meta.data))  #assume 1.6% doublets according to 10x
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi*(1-homotypic.prop))
```

```{r}
#Run doublet finder to determine optimal settings
BL6_VEH <- doubletFinder(BL6_VEH, PCs = 1:30, pN = 0.25, pK = 0.02, nExp = nExp_poi, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(BL6_VEH, group.by = "DF.classifications_0.25_0.02_25")
```

```{r}
BL6_VEH_singlets <- subset(BL6_VEH, cells = which(BL6_VEH@meta.data[["DF.classifications_0.25_0.02_25"]] == "Singlet"))
```


## CONFIGURE V(D)J INFORMATION
```{r}
BV_VDJ <- read.csv("BL6_VEH_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")
BS_VDJ <- read.csv("BL6_SEB_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")
CV_VDJ <- read.csv("C3H_VEH_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")
CS_VDJ <- read.csv("C3H_SEB_filtered_contig_annotations.csv")
```

```{r}
# Retain productive TCR contigs for downstream TCR metadata annotation and V gene/CDR3 analysis.
# Nonproductive contigs are excluded because they are not expected to encode functional TCR chains.
# Productive TRA and TRB chains are collapsed at the barcode level to preserve cells with multiple detected chains.

process_vdj <- function(vdj, sample_id) {
  vdj %>%
    filter(tolower(as.character(productive)) == "true") %>%
    group_by(barcode) %>%
    summarize(
      clonotype_id = unique(raw_clonotype_id)[1],
      TRA = paste(cdr3[chain == "TRA"], collapse = ";"),
      TRB = paste(cdr3[chain == "TRB"], collapse = ";"),
      cdr3 = paste(cdr3, collapse = ";"),
      cdr3_nt = paste(cdr3_nt, collapse = ";"),
      v_gene = paste(v_gene, collapse = ";")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id = sample_id
    )
}

# Process each dataset
BV_summary <- process_vdj(BV_VDJ, "BL6_VEH")
BS_summary <- process_vdj(BS_VDJ, "BL6_SEB")
CV_summary <- process_vdj(CV_VDJ, "C3H_VEH")
CS_summary <- process_vdj(CS_VDJ, "C3H_SEB")

# Combine
vdj_all <- bind_rows(BV_summary, BS_summary, CV_summary, CS_summary)

# Add prefixed barcode
vdj_all$barcode <- paste0(vdj_all$sample_id, "_", vdj_all$barcode)
rownames(vdj_all) <- vdj_all$barcode

saveRDS(vdj_all, file = "vdj_all.RDS")
```

```{r}
#make barcodes same in seurat object
seurat_list <- list(
 BL6_VEH = BL6_VEH_singlets,
 BL6_SEB = BL6_SEB_singlets,
 C3H_VEH = C3H_VEH_singlets,
 C3H_SEB = C3H_SEB_singlets
)

for (name in names(seurat_list)) {
  colnames(seurat_list[[name]]) <- paste0(name, "_", colnames(seurat_list[[name]]))
  seurat_list[[name]]$sample_id <- name
}
```

```{r}
#add VDJ info to seurat objects

for (sample in names(seurat_list)) {
  seurat <- seurat_list[[sample]]
  
  # Add empty columns if they don't already exist
  seurat$clonotype_id <- NA
  seurat$TCRa_cdr3 <- NA
  seurat$TCRb_cdr3 <- NA
  
  seurat_list[[sample]] <- seurat
}

for (sample in names(seurat_list)) {
  seurat <- seurat_list[[sample]]
  
  # Find matching barcodes
  common <- intersect(rownames(seurat@meta.data), vdj_all$barcode)
  
  # Add metadata using rownames as index
  seurat@meta.data[common, "clonotype_id"] <- vdj_all[common, "clonotype_id"]
  seurat@meta.data[common, "TCRa_cdr3"] <- vdj_all[common, "TRA"]
  seurat@meta.data[common, "TCRb_cdr3"] <- vdj_all[common, "TRB"]
  
  # Save back into list
  seurat_list[[sample]] <- seurat
}
```


##INTEGRATION 
```{r}
for (i in names(seurat_list)) {
  seurat_list[[i]] <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_list[[i]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
}
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = seurat_list)
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = seurat_list, anchor.features = features)
integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors)
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "integrated"

integrated <- ScaleData(integrated)
integrated <- RunPCA(integrated)
integrated <- RunUMAP(integrated, dims = 1:30)
integrated <- FindNeighbors(integrated, dims = 1:30)
integrated <- FindClusters(integrated, resolution = 0.8)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(integrated, group.by = "stim")  # if added
table(integrated$stim)
```

```{r}
integrated$stim <- recode(integrated$stim,
                          "BL6_VEH" = "C57BL/6J+VEH",
                          "BL6_SEB" = "C57BL/6J+SEB",
                          "C3H_VEH" = "C3H/HeJ+VEH",
                          "C3H_SEB" = "C3H/HeJ+SEB")

# Convert to factor and set the desired order
integrated$stim <- factor(integrated$stim, levels = c("C57BL/6J+VEH",
                                                      "C57BL/6J+SEB",
                                                      "C3H/HeJ+VEH",
                                                      "C3H/HeJ+SEB"))
```

```{r}
integrated <- JoinLayers(integrated, layers = c("data","counts","scale.data"))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
saveRDS(integrated, "integrated.RDS")
```

```{r}
#finding markers for each cluster
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "RNA"
integrated.markersRNA <- FindAllMarkers(integrated, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.5, logfc.threshold = 0.5)
integrated.markersRNA %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
```

```{r}
write.csv(integrated.markersRNA, "integrated_posRNA_cluster_markers.csv")
```

```{r}
#finding markers for each cluster
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "ADT"
integrated.markersADT <- FindAllMarkers(integrated, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.5, logfc.threshold = 0.5)
integrated.markersADT %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
```

```{r}
write.csv(integrated.markersADT, "integrated_posADT_cluster_markers.csv")
```
